requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The printer must support new NGB keyed bottles with a 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, and CMY bottles with a capacity greater than 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce user intervention and increase cost-effectiveness for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new keyed bottle designs and ink tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a new NGB keyed bottle is installed, the printer should recognize the bottle and deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle capacity exceeding 8,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The ink bottle and tank system must be designed to ensure spill-free operation during bottle installation and ink refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free design improves user experience and reduces mess and potential damage.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with NOA-F and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a user installs or refills ink, there should be no observable ink spillage under normal operating conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement a NOA-F (Non-Original Authentication Feature) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label; no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves anti-counterfeiting and ensures secure bottle authentication.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on NOA-F design and manufacturing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a bottle with NOA-F, the printer must authenticate it using the metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and the click-on mechanisms must remain unchanged.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink Formulations
requirements.Description: The printer must reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink formulations without requiring ink reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D costs and leverages proven technologies.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks, they must be compatible and perform to current standards in the new printer.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Performance Characterization
requirements.Description: Reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) must be characterized and modeled, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent performance and reliability over the product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new testing and modeling processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All key parameters must be characterized and meet predefined thresholds for startup and end-of-life.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Maintains high print quality and reduces ink-related failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires data from ink stability tests.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability models must predict PQ outcomes with >95% accuracy in lab tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Service and Contractual Obligations
requirements.Description: The printer and its consumables must support service/contractual requirements, including NOA-F as service parts under warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with HP’s warranty and service programs.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design and service part logistics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts must be available and serviceable under warranty claims.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 Integration on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances bottle authentication and traceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with lid design and manufacturing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 must be present and functional on all bottle lids shipped with the product.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modification for NOA-F and New Bottles
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5. Mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps required.
requirements.Rationale: Enables production of new consumables and ensures factory readiness.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires equipment upgrades and process changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines must be capable of producing NOA-F and new bottles with required caps and labeling.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components easily.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers must be able to replace PHA and NOA-F without tools or technical assistance, as verified by usability tests.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal: 80K Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations for reliability and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must reliably print 80,000 pages without major failures under standard usage.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS Business Model
requirements.Description: Enable printer and software features to support Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) offerings, including scheduling and management.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new business models and revenue streams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be managed, monitored, and billed as a service via HP’s platform.

requirements.Title: Increased Tank Size and Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Increase the tank size (Reddington ID) and optimize overall printer size to accommodate the tank, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity without impacting core features.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical design and integration with input/output trays.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer tank is increased in size, with input/output trays adjusted as needed, and no impact to ADF function.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for shipping and handling of the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product protection during transit.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipped units are packaged with EPS foam and pass drop/shock tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3 and LOT4 Environmental Compliance, Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer complies with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (for PDL SKU) environmental standards.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and market requirements for sustainability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications as applicable.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with the protruding tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures usability and compatibility with new tank size.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly and accommodate tank protrusion without impacting paper handling.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (color graphical display) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and ease of use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer features a 4.3” CGD that passes usability and display quality tests.

requirements.Title: Platform: 4 Tubes with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink flow and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer uses four tubes with new routing and passes flow and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station, with platform changes due to tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces ink aerosol emissions and maintains print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions are within HP’s safety and quality standards during service operations.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Develop and validate a dynamic and force model for the carriage, accounting for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable carriage motion and print accuracy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and motion tolerances under all configurations.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify paperpath to support increased page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable operation over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath components function reliably for at least 80,000 pages in testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design an ink maintenance part that can be serviced or replaced at a service center after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer life and reduces service costs for users.
requirements.Dependencies: Service center capabilities and part design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages as verified by service protocols.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection in IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection in the Ink Delivery System.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and maintainability of the ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes reliability and leak tests with new connections.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Utilize LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID for enhanced security and capacity.
requirements.Rationale: Increases security and supports higher ink volumes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank meets increased capacity and security criteria in lab tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the Ink Delivery System.
requirements.Rationale: Improves startup reliability and prevents air entrapment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes startup tests with new IDS algorithm and no air entrapment issues.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new algorithms for printer servicing and startup to support new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth operation and reduces servicing errors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer completes servicing and startup with new algorithms and no errors in field tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output quality and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets new PQ goals and depletion is accurately reported per defined metrics.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL, Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven hardware and reduces development costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components function within specification in the new printer.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module into the printer for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Provides modern wireless networking capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer connects to Wi-Fi networks using Stingray module and passes connectivity tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Use the Dune firmware platform for printer operation.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with HP firmware standards and feature sets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably using Dune firmware in all standard scenarios.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features at both hardware and firmware levels.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against security threats and ensures compliance with HP security standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes all Gauss4.xx security compliance tests.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solutions for SMB manageability and enterprise support, including WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM (HP Smart Management), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of business customers and enhances manageability.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB, Enterprise Customers, IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates with WJA, HPSM, and JAM and passes manageability tests.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility and support for a range of HP clients and drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes ecosystem compatibility and ease of deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer installs and operates correctly with all listed clients and drivers.

requirements.Title: High Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for speed in the target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard performance tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Support for hosting 12,000-page CMYK and trade page 6,000 yields as a flexible requirement.
requirements.Rationale: Expands product offering and addresses diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can support 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page yields if required by market.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the printer for easy maintenance box replacement to improve serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and maintenance effort for users and service providers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced without tools and passes serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Support a warranty life of 2 years for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive warranty period increases customer confidence and marketability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates within specification for 2 years under normal usage.
